'''Reid Smith''' is a Star Wars CCG tournament player. He was runner-up to Brandon Schele at the [[2004 World Championship]].<ref name="awards">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/community/awards/ Awards], Players Committee, starwarsccg.org. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20230817222457/https://www.starwarsccg.org/community/awards/ Internet Archive]</ref> The 2009 Match Play Championship pre-registration list gave his state as Pennsylvania (PA) and his username as ''3MW0J8''.<ref name="t22347">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=22347 MPC 2009 pre-registration list], Star Wars CCG Players Committee forum (9 August 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261012213614/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t22347.html Internet Archive]</ref> His 2010 and 2011 Worlds Day 2 sheets are printed ''R Smith'' with the same username.<ref name="w2010d2">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/tournaments/Decklists/2010/2010+Worlds+D2.pdf 2010 Worlds Day 2 decklists (PDF)], res.starwarsccg.org, pages 103–104. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008202452/http://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/tournaments/Decklists/2010/2010+Worlds+D2.pdf Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="w2011d2">[http://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/tournaments/Decklists/2011/Worlds/2011+World_d2.pdf 2011 Worlds Day 2 decklists (PDF)], res.starwarsccg.org, pages 13–14. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008202422/http://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/tournaments/Decklists/2011/Worlds/2011+World_d2.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>
